metadata.name: giveaways
metadata.description: ProofOfChance Giveaways Program - Transparent brand giveaways with proof-of-chance winner selection

instructions.name: attest_reveal
docs: Verify and include the participant's committed reveal directly on-chain.
This path does not require a provider receipt.

instructions.name: attest_uploaded
docs: Attest that proof-of-chance has been uploaded to provider
Anti-censorship mechanism - provider must include all attested participants.
Can only be called during upload/attestation window.

accounts.name: participant
docs: not need to sign, so any fee payer can relay an already-issued receipt.

instructions.name: begin_upload_phase
docs: Authority-only instruction to start upload/attestation phase now.

instructions.name: bind_registry
docs: One-time canonical registry binding, before any instance is created.

instructions.name: close_participant
docs: Close a participant account after giveaway settlement and reclaim rent

instructions.name: create_giveaway
docs: Create a new giveaway with locked funds
Creator deposits the configured total payout amount. Service fee is
taken from that amount during successful payout settlement.
Giveaway parameters are stored on-chain for transparency.

instructions.name: create_giveaway_with_nonce
docs: Durable creator-supplied nonce prevents duplicate creation across releases.

instructions.name: disqualify_participant
docs: Only giveaway creator can disqualify participants.
All disqualifications are logged for transparency.

instructions.name: extend_active_deadline
docs: Extend active deadline (only before current deadline)
Allows creator to extend participation window.
Cannot shorten or extend after deadline has passed.

instructions.name: finalize_winners
docs: Finalize winners and store merkle commitment
Provider-authorized instruction that processes a chunk of participants.
Once every participant is processed, stores the winner commitment
7..N. `[writable]` Reveal-included participant accounts for this chunk

accounts.name: authority
docs: Service-provider authority funds and advances every finalization chunk.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Sets up the global config account with authority and default parameters.
Can only be called once per deployment.

instructions.name: lock_winners
docs: Lock winners to prevent further changes
No more disqualifications or recomputes allowed after this.

instructions.name: participate
docs: Submit proof text and proof-of-chance commitment.
Can be called multiple times to update entry before deadline.

instructions.name: recompute_winners
docs: Disabled in the scalable finalization protocol. Disqualifications happen
before upload; `finalize_winners` processes the resulting eligible set in chunks.

instructions.name: settle_giveaway
docs: Refund a giveaway that never reached winner finalization
Handles no participants, no attesters, and expired omitted-reveal remediation

instructions.name: settle_no_eligible_giveaway
docs: Refund a finalized giveaway with zero eligible winners
Requires an existing winners ledger proving finalization completed with
`winners_count == 0`. This instruction never initializes the ledger.

instructions.name: settle_payout_batch
docs: Process a batch of winner payouts
Verifies merkle proofs and transfers funds directly to winners.
Can be called multiple times to process all winners in batches.

instructions.name: update_service_charge
docs: Updates the global service fee rate.
Only affects new giveaways created after this change.

instructions.name: upload_reveals
docs: Provider uploads plaintext proof-of-chance data for entropy generation.
Publication waits for the deadline or every eligible participant to
attest. All attested participants must be included before settlement.

types.name: Config
docs: Stores authority and default parameters for the giveaways program.
There is only one Config account per program deployment.

fields.name: authority
docs: Program authority who can update config and perform admin operations

fields.name: service_fee_bps
docs: Service fee rate in basis points (0-9999, where 10000 = 100%)

fields.name: default_active_duration_secs
docs: Default active duration in seconds for new giveaways

fields.name: default_upload_duration_secs
docs: Default upload/attestation duration in seconds for new giveaways

fields.name: last_updated_unix
docs: When this config was last updated

types.name: Giveaway
docs: Each giveaway is a unique instance with its own participants, funds, and settlement.
The giveaway follows a strict lifecycle from creation through settlement.
2. **Upload**: Participants upload PoC and attest (active_deadline_unix to upload_deadline_unix)
3. **Remediation**: Anyone can include signed/attested reveals omitted by the provider
4. **Settlement**: Winners compute only after all attested reveals are included
5. **Settled**: All winners paid and giveaway complete

fields.name: config
docs: Config account that created this giveaway

fields.name: upload_start_unix
docs: When upload/attestation window starts (same as active_deadline_unix)

fields.name: settlement_start_unix
docs: When settlement began (0 if not started)

fields.name: attested_count
docs: Number of participants who attested upload

fields.name: provider_uploaded_count
docs: Number of reveals uploaded by provider

fields.name: poc_aggregate_hash
docs: Aggregate hash of uploaded reveals, used as the deterministic entropy base

fields.name: uploads_complete
docs: Whether all attested reveals required for settlement have been uploaded

fields.name: winners_locked
docs: Whether winners are locked (no more changes allowed)

fields.name: remediation_start_unix
docs: When omitted-reveal remediation began (0 if not active/needed)

fields.name: remediation_deadline_unix
docs: When omitted-reveal remediation expires (0 if not active/needed)

fields.name: account_version
docs: Serialized account layout version for controlled upgrades.

fields.name: provider_authority
docs: Provider/fee authority fixed at creation for this event.

fields.name: settlement_deadline_unix
docs: Absolute finalization cutoff, independent of when remediation starts.

types.name: Participant
docs: Each participant has one account per giveaway containing their
proof text, commitment hash, and participation status.

fields.name: giveaway
docs: Giveaway this participant is enrolled in

fields.name: commitment_hash
docs: Proof-of-chance commitment hash (SHA256 of lucky_words || 0x1f || salt)

fields.name: proof_text
docs: Proof text submitted by participant (social links, handles, etc.)

fields.name: attested_uploaded
docs: Whether participant has attested to uploading reveal

fields.name: attested_at_unix
docs: When attestation was submitted (0 if not attested)

fields.name: reveal_included
docs: Whether reveal has been included in provider upload

fields.name: disqualification_reason
docs: Disqualification reason code (0 if not disqualified)

fields.name: disqualified_at_unix
docs: When participant was disqualified (0 if not disqualified)

fields.name: created_at_unix
docs: When this participant entry was created

fields.name: last_updated_unix
docs: When this participant entry was last updated

fields.name: merkle_proof
docs: Legacy ABI field; protocol v2 verifies the participant PDA directly.
